en: Colorized early-20th‑century postcard showing a bustling city square with a prominent statue, tram tracks and a bridge over a river, surrounded by multi‑story buildings. Caption on the front reads in Slovene and German "Ljubljana – Marijin trg / Laibach." The reverse bears an Austro‑Hungarian stamp, a purple censorship mark, handwritten message and an address to Hall in Tyrol.
